name: UTI Asset Management Company Ltd
title: UTI Asset Management Company Ltd - 543238 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Asset manager with no capacity cycle; FY26 core PAT up only 3% to Rs 460 cr, equity net sales near zero, cost base growing 15% with growth-led guidance and flat-to-weak yield outlook.

triggers.label: Yield dilution 1-2 bps FY27
triggers.quote: maybe a basis point or two dilution in the overall yield number per se for Financial Year 26-27

triggers.label: Equity net flows near zero FY26
triggers.quote: This year, it was I would say almost close to zero

triggers.label: Other admin cost guided +7-8% standalone
triggers.quote: it should increase close to around 7% to 8% for the standalone entity

guidance.metric: Standalone employee cost run rate per quarter
guidance.quote: the run rate on a quarterly basis should be around Rs. 90 crores to Rs. 95 crores for the standalone entity

guidance.metric: Consolidated employee cost run rate per quarter
guidance.quote: Rs. 125 crores to Rs. 130 crores on the consolidated firm
it should increase close to around 7% to 8% for the standalone entity
for the consolidated one, it could be in the range of around 10%
maybe a basis point or two dilution in the overall yield number per se for Financial Year 26-27
UTI AMC has declared a dividend of Rs. 40 per share for the Financial Year ‘25 -26

red_flags.label: Equity net sales near zero; outflows in legacy schemes
red_flags.quote: This year, it was I would say almost close to zero

red_flags.label: Foreign outflow hitting international AUM
red_flags.quote: our international business honestly is just feeling the pain of that outflow front and center

evasions.quote: Well, I would love to do anything if you have ideas about how I could get all the funds into first quartile simultaneously.
I think too early to call that out.
